_description: LIMEN Entity Registry — company, business, profession, and institution entities attached to domain portals. Entities attach to portals/subportals, NOT directly to top-level domains.

_entity_schema.entityType: company | business | profession | institution | government_body | ngo
_entity_schema.name: string — legal or common entity name
_entity_schema.ticker: string | null — stock ticker if publicly traded
_entity_schema.cik: string | null — SEC Central Index Key
_entity_schema.subportalId: string | null — subportal if deeper attachment needed
_entity_schema.domainRelevance: string — why this entity matters to the domain
_entity_schema.portalRelevance: string — specific role within this portal's scope
